meta.title: Verified NFL league & 2026 season facts
meta.note: Every row was checked on 2026-11-01 against the linked official source. Dynamic values (standings, odds, injuries) carry an as-of timestamp and must be re-pulled from the linked live page; they are never hard-coded as permanent truth.

rows.value: 32 teams: 16 AFC + 16 NFC; each conference has 4 divisions (East/North/South/West) of 4 teams
18 weeks, 272 games; each team plays 17 regular-season games + 3 preseason games; one bye week per team
Kickoff Wed Sept 9, 2026 (Seahawks host Patriots, Lumen Field); Week 18 = Jan 9-10, 2027 with all 16 games divisional; 14-team playoff (7 per conference) in effect since 2020
Record 9 international regular-season games; Week 9 = Madrid (Bengals at Falcons, Sun Nov 8, 9:30 AM ET, NFLN); also Melbourne, Rio de Janeiro, London x3, Paris, Mexico City, Munich
Week 8 games concluding Sun Nov 1, 2026; Week 9 begins Thu Nov 5 (Jaguars at Ravens, 8:15 PM); Week 9 byes: Steelers, Titans
MIN 6-0-0; SF 6-1-0; BUF 5-1-0; KC 5-1-0; CHI/CLE/DEN/PIT 5-2-0 (live page — re-pull for current values)

nfl.com/stats/player-stats publishes official passing/rushing/receiving/fumbles/tackles/INT/FG/kicking/punting categories by season (back to 1920); 2026 leaders live e.g. QB passing: Jordan Love 2,246 yds
nfl.com/stats/team-stats publishes official offense/defense/special-teams team stats by season

rows.fact: Official player tracking data (Next Gen Stats)
rows.value: NFL-operated tracking captures location/speed/acceleration of every player every play (RFID + UWB, 10 readings/sec, AWS); public charts/stats at nextgenstats.nfl.com; NGS stats post the day after each game

rows.fact: Official EPA / success-rate usage by the league
rows.value: NFL's own matchup-advantage scores are built from success rate and EPA per play plus EPA production; official explainer videos for EPA & Success Rate published on nfl.com/next-gen-stats

Weekly official injury report at nfl.com/injuries (Week 8, 2026 live on 2026-11-01) with practice status (DNP/Limited/Full) and game status (Questionable/Doubtful/Out); clubs file practice reports by 4:00 p.m. ET on practice days and a Game Status Report before each game

rows.fact: Official NFL team roster listing; depth chart order
rows.value: NFL.com team page returns a player roster listing. The inspected page does not provide a depth-chart ordering; starter/backup/2nd/3rd/4th-string designations are therefore unverified and left blank.
Full official 2026 NFL rulebook published by NFL Football Operations (with 2026 rule changes)

Nevada Regulation 22 requires sports-pool wager outcomes to be confirmable from official public records of the league/governing body or its designated statistics provider — i.e., NFL official stats are the grading source of truth

rows.fact: Live market lines snapshot (as of 2026-11-01, Week 8 Sunday slate at DraftKings)
Official weather source for outdoor games
